summary: Root-caused and fixed real-player slash knockback being canceled by its own movement lock; documented a Trust Tier/Lag Compensation authority model for future combat/movement systems.

Validated in Studio Play by directly firing ODMGear_SlashKnockback at the local test player and sampling velocity: post-fix it holds steady for the impulse duration then decays through a natural gravity arc; pre-fix it was pinned at exactly zero the whole lock window. No console errors. Two-real-player hands-on validation is still required. Separately, added a Trust Tier Model (Zero-Trust Truth vs Feel-Critical Client-Assisted) and a Lag Compensation Baseline (favor-the-attacker, server-measured rewind cap, timestamp-based overlap vs rule-based winner selection) to AuthorityPolicy.md so future combat/movement systems don't default to full server re-simulation, and a documented anti-pattern (movement locks silently canceling physics-driven effects) so this class of bug is easier to avoid next time.
